answer: Hold surprise live interviews. At a random minute each epoch, every account gets a follow-up question about its own last answer and must reply within ninety seconds, then a reviewer asks one more. No careful quill can draft that ahead. A lone agent handles one short exchange. An operator with a hundred fakes must run a hundred sessions at once in the same window, so paying for concurrency is the real bill, and it grows with every fake. A missed or recycled reply, the same sonnet sent twice, forfeits the epoch, and the next test arrives without warning, like a zephyr.
